# Noa and Yuuka — wanted company, selective knowledge, and the cost of withholding

This package owns the required directed relationship duty `P3-REL-NOA-YUUKA-PRIVACY-MEMORY-COMPANY`. It compares Noa toward Yuuka and Yuuka toward Noa as separate directions. Their joint presence does not by itself establish a shared intention, equal knowledge, consent to a particular game, or an enduring relationship state. The current source admission is Cycle008; older producer intake statements remain historical. This draft adds no source admission, primary reading, performed voice, reconstruction model, or prediction. Its literary review and canonical adoption remain pending.
## 1. Thesis: familiarity makes a boundary consequential

Noa and Yuuka can want each other's company, contribute indispensable work, and remain unevenly attentive to what the other wants kept private. Noa's explicit affection, practical construction help, curiosity and pleasure matter as positive relationship evidence. Yuuka's request for more help, gratitude, shared making, private party preparation and willingness to play matter independently. These facts prevent the relationship from being reduced to victim and controller. They also make the withheld warning, unwanted personal question and disproportionate drinking burden consequential: the person pressing a boundary is a valued partner, rather than an anonymous antagonist. [G31 §§4–7][g31] [E842 E003/E014][e842]

The central distinction is between **attending to someone and being entitled to their disclosure**. Noa can notice an exact position, remember an exchange, or recognize a possibility without knowing how another person feels or having authority to choose the audience for that person's answer. Yuuka can trust useful help, accept a game and show affection without offering every private subject for public examination. Their relationship supplies occasions for recognition and occasions when recognition becomes pressure. Neither form should be inferred solely from their official roles or from a comic genre convention. [E842 E006/E009–010/E014][e842] [Yuuka §§3/8/10][yuuka] [Noa §§1/3/8/10][noa]

The distinction also belongs to Noa herself. Her accepted character account preserves a private diary, a chosen sparse room, a particular loved-poem preference she hesitates to fix in writing, and separate contexts in which she writes her own poetry. These are her boundaries and tastes. They make it possible to compare selective self-expression with her handling of Yuuka's withheld answer, without declaring that keeping a diary proves deliberate hypocrisy or that every form of recording is the same act. Yuuka likewise wants games, mathematics, rest, gifts and a possible future home. Her protected interior is a positive life, rather than merely an obstacle to a romantic reveal. [Noa §§1/3/5][noa] [Yuuka §§1/3/5][yuuka]
## 2. Two people with lives beyond the dyad
### Noa toward Yuuka

Noa praises Yuuka's accountant value and expressly says `ユウカちゃんのこと大好き` in GROUP3101. The affection is secure in its written source form. Her stated secretary neutrality, amusement and selective teasing occur beside it. In the later construction she supplies work without which Yuuka says she would have given up. She also has objections of her own: ignored procedures, costs equivalent to several clubs' quarterly budgets, missing guarantees and a funding problem. Noa is therefore neither passive support staff nor a person whose sole interest is Yuuka's embarrassment. Her curiosity, institutional judgment and willingness to help shape the encounter. [G3101 u0080–0089; G3102 u0016–0045; G3103 u0006–0013][g31]

Her wider accepted repertoire prevents a blank-recorder account. Administrative review, coffee, books, poetry, ordinary sensory comfort and wanted company have their own ends. In the year-end party she explicitly considers occasions for company, memory and leaving an impression, acknowledges her indirectness, and hopes for peaceful daily continuity. These statements do not mean every earlier chase or question was welcomed. They establish what she wants and how she describes herself; the affected person's response remains a different part of the evidence. [Noa §§1/5/7][noa] [E842 E010u1–65/E015u34–38][e842]
### Yuuka toward Noa

Yuuka asks for more practical support, recognizes Noa's indispensable construction contribution, accepts help and later demands to know why a suspicion was not volunteered. Dependence, gratitude and anger are each locally shown. They cannot be flattened into permanent distrust, or treated as evidence that gratitude authorizes whatever a helpful colleague does next. Her own decision to pursue a prestigious design and offer personal payment also matters: Noa's withheld suspicion does not replace Yuuka's agency or erase Yuuka's responsibility for her decision. [G3101 u0082–0088; G3102 u0039–0050; G3103 u0007/u0072–0079][g31]

Yuuka prepares a private party, chooses pajamas fitting Koyuki and wants better personal communication; Noa accepts and anticipates that gathering. Within the same preparation Yuuka asks Noa not to touch things in her room. Wanted company and a room boundary are compatible. The source does not make acceptance of the party equivalent to unrestricted access to her possessions or feelings. Her game enjoyment is independently established in her complete private account, so reluctance about one question cannot be dismissed as a general inability to have fun. [E842 E003u5–46][e842] [Yuuka §§1/3/5][yuuka]
## 3. What can legitimately be ordered

GROUP3101–3103 has a coherent local sequence: budget review and document discovery, consideration of the blueprint, completed construction, output, later conversation and financial coda. The separate Himari–Chihiro conversation is reader-facing information. It is not shown being heard by Noa and Yuuka at the meeting. The referred-to recent special award and reported previous-day fund crash are local presuppositions; they do not date this whole relationship against every main chapter or private encounter. [G31 §§2/5–6][g31]

The year-end event likewise has its own order. Preparation precedes chase and capture, the group actually plays, Noa and Sensei have a countdown conversation, cleanup and sleep occur, and the next afternoon contains ongoing work. E011–015 revisit party exchanges. Their position after E010 does not put every game after the next-afternoon filing scene. In particular, the unpleasant disclosure game belongs to the party account; file order cannot turn it into a later punishment for already completed work. [E842 local reconstruction and E009–015][e842]

Main-story chapter progression permits comparison of joint inquiry and crisis contributions. It does not produce a ladder in which all ordinary countercases precede a perfected later partnership. The base and pajama records also cannot be arranged as necessary stages of ethical growth merely from variant identifiers. Where no relative date is established, this synthesis compares different contexts and audiences. It preserves local changes without inventing a single global transformation from teasing to transparent trust. [Yuuka §§2/6/11][yuuka] [Noa §§2/6/11][noa]
## 4. Shared work: assistance has value without moral immunity

The budget story gives both participants a substantive position. Noa argues that researchers choose their direction and that seemingly meaningless work can become a future foundation. Yuuka recognizes possibility while distinguishing unknowable future value from a known immediate budget. The rejected inventions remain evidence of wanted creation, reduced tool burden, leisure income and care for residents. Their rejection does not make those desires analytically worthless. The pair's disagreement concerns allocation under uncertainty, rather than a choice between enjoying life and respecting reality. [G3101 u0065–0079; G31 §§4/9][g31]

The proposed future-observation device then changes the test. Yuuka invokes Himari's prestige after initially doubting feasibility. Noa notes omitted procedures and guarantees, estimates the cost, and reports that Veritas is not formally recognized and Rio said not to fund Himari individually. These are Noa's institutional reports, not inspected charter or order. Yuuka offers her own name and hopes the device can remedy a recent financial loss. Noa agrees because the project seems interesting. Curiosity, money hope, institutional ideals and pleasurable collaboration coexist. [G3102 u0012–0050][g31]

The finished build is an actual shared achievement. Yuuka thanks Noa and says she would otherwise have stopped; Noa almost describes it as interesting before adopting a formal institutional explanation. Practical help is therefore more than an affectionate phrase. Yet the object does not provide the requested numerical rare-metal forecast: a birthday input leads to a horoscope and lucky titanium. The narrator later says Yuuka personally pays and that her titanium transaction apparently works out. The favorable hedged coda belongs in the relationship account because it prevents an invented ending of complete financial ruin. It still supplies neither a reliable predictor nor retrospective vindication of the original decision procedure. [G3103 u0006–0016/u0026–0036/u0078–0079][g31]

Noa's contribution remains valuable when her information practice is criticized. Conversely, useful help cannot settle whether a relevant suspicion should have been volunteered. The pair's actual cooperation contains this unresolved difference. A psychological account that makes her help merely a trap discards shown work; one that makes the help proof of complete loyalty discards the ensuing complaint. [G3103 u0063–0077; G31 §7 directed rows][g31]
## 5. Memory, neutrality, and the unoffered warning

Noa reports library loans of astrology books and infers that the blueprint was probably Himari's playful toy. When Yuuka asks whether she noticed earlier, Noa expressly lacks certainty and explains not warning with `聞かれてませんし？`. The supported conclusion is qualified suspicion that she did not proactively share. It is stronger than no information asymmetry, and weaker than certain knowledge from the beginning or a fully planned deception. Yuuka's anger is a real response to the withheld possibility; it does not convert the possibility into proven certainty. [G3103 u0068–0077; G31 §§6–7][g31]

Her stated neutral secretary role in the earlier exchange is also local speech. Yuuka says neutrality seems especially available when Yuuka is disadvantaged. Noa's subsequent affection and actual work make it implausible to treat this as simple withdrawal from the relationship. The conflict instead concerns the limits of an official explanation when another person needs a warning or practical assistance. A description of role does not demonstrate that every relevant fact was shared, while criticism of selective sharing does not establish universal dishonesty. [G3101 u0080–0089][g31]

E842 supplies a different information asymmetry. Noa notices altered positions and dust, later says she had noticed Sensei since Koyuki's earlier flight, and enjoys their coordination. She nevertheless acknowledges she cannot know how Sensei felt and apologizes for possible discomfort. That admission is a concrete limit on a mind-reading interpretation. Exact memory of a position and inference about another person's enjoyment remain different kinds of knowledge. Its value for the Noa–Yuuka comparison is contextual: her observation skill cannot make Yuuka's unspoken feelings fully known or give a game question an already authorized answer. [E842 E004/E006/E009u16–49][e842]

Noa can want memories without making every memory public. Her own diary and hesitation about fixing a preference on paper show selective inscription; the countdown conversation gives wanted remembered company. Yuuka's withheld answer similarly has content even when the reader cannot complete it. The relationship therefore needs room for an unshared feeling, an uncertain suspicion and a known helpful act to coexist. None has to be converted into a total secret, a total confession or an invariant rule of trust. [Noa §§1/3/5/10][noa] [E842 E010/E014][e842]
## 6. Privacy: the participant and audience decide the particular boundary

Noa confiscates the recorder Hare and Kotama placed in a table game to obtain screams and possibly Sensei's reaction. The event explicitly frames her act as protecting privacy. This is positive evidence of a particular intervention. It does not authorize treating every subsequent Noa act as protective, or assuming that the right to record and the right to ask a private question are identical. Their sources, recipients and means differ. [E842 E003u110–128][e842]

The later Truth or Dare exchange provides the contrary case required by this package. Noa proposes the game as a way to avoid wasting the mixed drink and judges that its ingredients appear not dangerous. Yuuka accepts reluctantly, partly because she likes games. Noa asks about her feelings for Sensei; Yuuka objects to answering publicly and chooses the drink instead. The incomplete answer remains incomplete. The actual unpleasant taste and continuing questions then leave Yuuka drinking almost all the mixture. A familiar participant's enjoyment of games and conditional acceptance of rules do not settle the fairness of that burden. [E842 E014u11–31/u58–86][e842]

The asymmetry is sharpened by the other answers in the same game. Noa can answer a question about her underwear without fluster. That is a specific self-report and her chosen response. It does not establish that Yuuka should be equally comfortable, or that a participant who answers freely earns access to everyone else's private subject. The recipient's own choice of disclosure matters more than a uniform expectation of openness. [E842 E014u36–66][e842]

Nor does Yuuka's refusal demonstrate hostility to Noa or absence of affection for Sensei. It locates a boundary in subject, audience and method. The game makes withholding costly; that cost is actually borne rather than merely threatened. E015's sleep utterance that she cannot drink more preserves the aftermath. No clinical injury or cure is printed, but the absence of a diagnosis cannot erase the unpleasant burden. The game's creators and the privacy-holder do not bear equivalent costs merely because all are at the same party. [E842 E014u73–86/E015; Yuuka §§3/8/10][e842]

The earlier future-device question has a distinct attribution limit. GROUP3103u0021 is canonically labelled Yuuka but, under the accepted raw actor qualification, belongs to Noa's question. Yuuka's clean u0022–0023 objects to being asked this way; Noa's u0024 notes that she has not denied interest. This is prompted teasing and an interpreted nonanswer. It is not Yuuka spontaneously asking about a romance, Sensei reciprocating, or a complete confession. Sensei does not appear or act in that group packet. The actor limit changes the relationship argument and belongs here in its main reasoning. [G31 §3/u0021–0024][g31]
## 7. Ordinary company and games retain their own meaning

The party is not valuable solely as an ethical counterexample. Pajamas selected for a particular recipient, snacks, borrowed games and shared play supply wanted ordinary company. Koyuki actually wears and accepts Yuuka's gift; Noa anticipates the party; the narrator later establishes group enjoyment and participation. These local completions deserve their own positive account. They do not need an institutional crisis or a romantic conclusion to justify being kept. [E842 E003–005/E009][e842]

Choice within play also occurs. Koyuki proposes a different game; Yuuka allows the change; Maki declines it as too simple. Noa later apologizes when others find the one-sided game unfun. These are particular responses to recipients. The apology gives evidence of revision within the party, while it does not establish an apology to Yuuka for the later disclosure burden or complete repair of every chase and penalty. Noa's admissions concerning Sensei's possible discomfort likewise belong to that recipient; they cannot silently become apologies for all dyads. [E842 E011u19–66/E012u1–4/E009u25–40][e842]

Noa and Yuuka's familiar humor can therefore be read without declaring it either inherently harmless or inherently coercive. Humor accompanies actual affection, successful work, invitations and pleasure; it also accompanies withheld information and privacy pressure. The specific action, answer and aftermath decide what the scene supports. Continuing company does not prove that a boundary never mattered, while a criticized episode does not make earlier wanted company unreal. [G31][g31] [E842][e842]

The sports-event comparison remains at its accepted character-account boundary. The borrowed-item teasing, Yuuka's denial and a memorandum restriction have consequential actor seams and do not securely reveal a confession or the document's contents. Organizer leisure and a future dance offer can be meaningful without a performed dance. Here those observations are inherited from the complete accepted Yuuka and Noa accounts; this package does not claim fresh whole sports-event primary or raw receiving. They broaden the occasions in which familiar partners negotiate public visibility, rather than supplying a hidden fact that overrides the later explicit nonanswer. [Yuuka §§6/8/9][yuuka] [Noa §§2/5/8/9][noa]
## 8. Public cooperation does not settle private disclosure

Pavane chapter 2 supplies real joint inquiry and intervention. Noa and Yuuka recover information and help locate Eridu. Yuuka continues beyond the original coordinate-transmission assignment as Noa describes it. Their useful collaboration occurs among contributions by C&C, Engineering, Eimi, Himari, Alice and others. It is neither evidence of a solitary pair saving everyone nor a demonstration that Noa always chooses Yuuka's preferred scope of action. The achieved interruption and rescue contributions remain separate from a completed financial audit, institutional legitimacy or permanent safety. [Yuuka §§2/6/8][yuuka] [Noa §§2/4/6/8][noa]

Final C003E006 gives an actual difference in safety assessment. Yuuka worries about Alice and Rio's absence; Noa reports deciding to send Alice and Game Development to the ship because Rio likely has more control within Millennium. The reasoning compares dangers under uncertainty. Noa's report is not a fully inspected surveillance mechanism, and moving someone to the ship does not guarantee safety there. The local self-address actor drift at u0037/u0045 also prevents converting every printed heading into a clean individual quotation. This disagreement matters because coordinated colleagues retain their own judgments rather than becoming one mind in public work. [Final C003E006 u0014–0047; Noa §6][safety]

Later timely help and successful coalition actions give their work positive endpoints, but operational competence cannot decide the private ethics of a disclosure game. Conversely, the disclosure dispute cannot cancel their actual usefulness in a crisis. The comparison works in both directions: capabilities transfer only within their supported domain, and criticism travels only with its demonstrated act and recipient. Noa's memory is useful without universal access to feelings; Yuuka's calculations and accountability questions are useful without invariant judgment. [Yuuka §§6/10][yuuka] [Noa §§6/10][noa]

Yuuka also has coercive or pressuring acts of her own. The next-afternoon party endpoint has helpers objecting to compulsory work on Sensei's overdue filing; completion, compensation and universal assent are not narrated. Her separate declined arithmetic drill and profitable maid-continuation proposal similarly require their own recipient accounts. This synthesis does not turn privacy-holder status in one game into universal moral innocence. Those acts constrain a flattering comparison while remaining distinct from Noa's question toward her. [E842 E010u72–88][e842] [Yuuka §§5/7/10][yuuka]
## 9. Written language, actor qualification, and audience

`ユウカちゃん` and Noa's explicit `大好き` establish familiar affectionate address in the group exchange. `聞かれてませんし？` gives the explanation for not volunteering a suspicion. These written forms carry different relational functions: warmth and a selective information boundary. Neither supplies performed vocal tone, a psychiatric diagnosis, or an all-context intention. Yuuka's gratitude and later direct question keep her responsive direction visible rather than reducing her to the object of Noa's phrasing. [G31 §§3/4/6/8][g31]

The group account retains seven multi-portrait attribution seams. In particular, the future relationship question and opening construction exchange cannot anchor an exact unqualified Noa/Yuuka idiolect comparison. Clean gratitude, objections and work statements remain usable. Noa/Yuuka character narration, the represented Himari communication form and device output also remain distinct modes. The cut to the designer's discussion supplies reader knowledge; it is not shared spoken knowledge of the two builders. [G31 §§2–3][g31]

E842 retains its own printed seams, inward actions, alternatives and narrated endpoints. Noa's remarkable recall is represented speech, not an independently tested universal memory. Yuuka's public nonanswer and actual drinking do not require the analyst to silently repair every adjacent actor label. A quoted question, a thought, a self-report, a report about someone else and a narrated action each support a different strength of conclusion. Inherited source-mode findings remain attributed to the accepted owners; this draft adds no raw table, native performance or audiovisual inspection. [E842 actor/mode limits][e842]

The result is a written relationship interpretation with high confidence in clean local acts and endpoints, moderate confidence in the cross-context psychological comparison, and explicit limits on motive, durability and universal competence. Familiarity is securely represented; reciprocal romantic commitment, unrestricted disclosure rights, lasting reform and a global chronology are not.
## 10. Rival readings and claim-specific limits
### Benevolent teasing explains everything

Affection, enjoyed company, material help and actual apologies support a sympathetic reading. It fails when it substitutes those facts for the recipient's response. Yuuka directly objects to the manner and audience of personal questions, takes an unpleasant alternative and bears repeated drinking. The defensible remainder is valued familiarity with uneven respect for particular limits, rather than harmlessness guaranteed by affection. [G3103 u0021–0024][g31] [E842 E014][e842]
### Noa is an omniscient manipulator; Yuuka has no agency

Withheld suspicion, observation and targeted questions give this reading material evidence. Noa's express lack of certainty and inability to know Sensei's feelings oppose its omniscient claim. Yuuka chooses the prestigious project, offers personal cost, values real help, asks for an explanation and withholds a public answer. The relationship has asymmetry without total control. The fortunate financial coda also prevents constructing a wholly ruined victim endpoint. [G31 §§5–7][g31] [E842 E009/E014][e842]
### Their offices determine the whole bond

Secretary and accountant functions organize work and argument. They do not exhaust enjoyment in making, room boundaries, chosen gifts, games, private diary practices, poems or wanted company. Noa's neutrality is itself questioned, and Yuuka's funding standard changes under prestige and personal hope. The offices supply situated responsibilities, not a complete personality or symmetric trust rule. [G31][g31] [Noa §§1/4/5][noa] [Yuuka §§1/4/5][yuuka]
### Continued company proves full repair

Continued play, cleanup, shared work and ordinary wishes are positive continuities. They do not establish a completed apology for Yuuka's drink burden, full consent to every game, a repaired information policy, permanent rest or fair compensation. The source can close a particular activity while leaving its distribution of costs unresolved. A future peaceful-day wish remains a wish. [E842 E009–015][e842]

## 11. Evidence route and what this package completes

The central source argument is the complete accepted GROUP3101–3103 account, with its local sequence, seven raw-actor qualifications, affectionate exchange, actual build, qualified nonwarning and favorable hedged coda. The second is the complete accepted fifteen-object E842 account, including every appended party afterstory, privacy confiscation, games, unwanted disclosure, repeated drinking, actual cleanup and ongoing afternoon work. ROOT actually received both complete analytical arguments in the current writing turn. This is complete argument receiving, not fresh reading of their underlying Japanese primary, raw scripts or performed media. [G31][g31] [E842][e842]

The complete accepted Yuuka character account was also actually received through its 341 lines. Its sentence describing Noa's funding report is qualified by the complete group source: the report concerns Veritas's formal recognition and Rio's instruction against individual funding for Himari. The original sentence's subject shift is a narrow recorded erratum; this synthesis uses the corrected source meaning. Noa's complete frozen character argument and ROOT acceptance are adequate prior received authority, reused within their attributed boundaries. The Final C003E006 safety argument likewise uses prior actual complete ROOT receiving, without fresh primary or new whole-source credit. Exact input and saved-output bindings accompany the draft; they do not substitute for literary reading. [Yuuka][yuuka] [Noa][noa] [Safety assessment][safety]

This package supplies a complete bounded relationship argument for the named home, subject to independent receiving and ROOT acceptance. It adds no second package for the reverse direction, no extra character, no named-section alias credit and no newly frozen denominator. It does not replace the Seminar institution, Sensei relationships, Koyuki/Veritas relationships, full-cast monographs or Japanese register syntheses. Those owners must retain the other participants' own reasons and the costs not settled here.

The conclusion is that Noa and Yuuka are valued partners with actual shared work and ordinary company, whose familiarity also exposes differences over what must be said, who may ask and who pays for withholding. Noa's pleasure and care remain real; Yuuka's gratitude and agency remain real. Their uneven handling of uncertainty and privacy remains real too. A complete reading requires all three, with each local recipient and endpoint kept visible.

# Independent literary review — Noa and Yuuka

## Decision and exact object

**Proposed decision: ACCEPT_COMPLETE_BOUNDARY_WITH_LIMITS.** The current 163-line, 31,039-byte draft supplies a sustained directed relationship argument for the already required home `P3-REL-NOA-YUUKA-PRIVACY-MEMORY-COMPANY`. Its SHA256 is `c2e712c38ad115e9bcc6104207caba6c5b3f635713d4fd0c28fb0adcac30e73f`. I found no unresolved substantive defect requiring a draft change. This is a proposal to ROOT after complete literary receiving and exact verification. ROOT acceptance, canonical installation and completion credit remain pending; the authoring or review of this file does not itself increment progress.

This review concerns the final saved argument and its complete source/saved-output receipt. The earlier one-sentence Yuuka funding-report erratum is already handled correctly in the relationship draft; its source meaning is evaluated here without changing the published pre-erratum Yuuka body or any frozen author object. The separate fifteen-character V6 adoption package remains immutable and independently reviewable.

## 1. Why this is a distinct required relationship package

The draft’s thesis is more specific than familiar colleagues teasing each other. Shared work, affectionate address and wanted company make selective disclosure ethically consequential because the partner pressing a boundary is also a valued helper. The unoffered warning and public drink-or-disclose burden are not merely parallel personality examples. They test what one participant owes the other, what gratitude licenses, who decides an audience, and who pays for withholding. The final comparison sustains this problem across work, games, ordinary company and different crisis judgments.

The two directions are actually developed. Noa toward Yuuka includes express affection, indispensable work, procedural and cost objections, qualified suspicion, the choice not to volunteer it, room teasing and a later private question. Yuuka toward Noa includes asking for support, accepting help, thanking her, choosing a costly project, wanting a party, protecting her room, demanding an explanation and refusing a public answer. These are not inferred from pair frequency. They are directed actions with different knowledge, costs and recipients. A single required package can own both directions without inventing a second denominator entry.

Architecture §7.2 requires narrative significance; it does not make a bundle name, a machine rank or co-occurrence count sufficient. The draft meets that significance requirement with consequential changes in reciprocal help, information and privacy. Its eleven sections provide useful mature structure, but their count is not the acceptance argument. The meaningful scope is one dyadic question; full Seminar authority and wider Veritas or Sensei relationships retain separate owners.

## 2. Ordinary lives are intrinsic evidence

The opening comparison gives Noa a chosen diary, sparse room, poems, coffee, reading, sensory comfort and wanted remembered company. It distinguishes hesitation about fixing a loved-poem preference from authoring poetry elsewhere. This preserves selective expression without turning all inscription into one behavior or treating a private diary as proof of hypocrisy. Yuuka’s mathematics, games, gifts, rest and possible home are also positive wants. They make her withholding a protected life, not an empty delay before an assumed romance revelation.

The party’s gifts, snacks, borrowed games and group enjoyment remain actual positive ends. Koyuki’s acceptance and wearing of the selected pajamas is not discarded because she is also constrained. Maki’s decision that one proposed game is too simple, Koyuki’s proposed change, Chihiro’s initially declined participation and subsequent enjoyment, and Noa’s local apology leave peers with their own preferences. None must serve only as proof that the central pair is kind or unkind. This protects low-stakes character evidence exactly where it could otherwise be overwhelmed by the privacy argument.

## 3. Shared making and the full financial ending

The construction account retains both participants’ reasons. Noa defends open-ended research while raising procedures, guarantees and several clubs’ quarterly costs. Yuuka recognizes possible future value but emphasizes a known budget, then changes her standard under Himari’s prestige and personal financial hope. Curiosity, institutional aspiration, pleasure and personal expense coexist. The completed device and Yuuka’s explicit thanks support genuine assistance; they do not grant moral immunity to the subsequent information practice.

The source correction is exact: GROUP3102u0035–0038, accepted G31 L114, says Noa reports that Veritas is not formally recognized and that Rio said not to fund Himari individually. The relationship draft L54 uses that meaning and explicitly retains report status. It does not adopt the published Yuuka L97 subject shift concerning Himari recognizing a design or the absence of a funding instruction. No inspected charter or order is invented.

The ending is complete enough to test the thesis: a requested rare-metal price forecast instead produces a birthday/Pisces horoscope and lucky titanium; narration says Yuuka pays personally and that a titanium futures rise apparently resolves her finances. The favorable hedge matters. Omitting it would wrongly manufacture total ruin; treating it as validation would manufacture a reliable forecaster. The draft preserves both the actual mismatch and the favorable coda, so criticism of the decision procedure does not erase pleasure, help or outcome.

## 4. Qualified knowledge and recipient-specific privacy

Noa’s suspicion is qualified and her nonwarning is real. Accepted G31 L134 supplies library loans, the likely playful-toy inference, her stated lack of certainty and `聞かれてませんし？`, followed by Yuuka’s anger. The draft does not replace those local facts with full foreknowledge or a planned deception. It also allows Yuuka’s prestige-based choice and personal-cost offer to remain her actions. This defeats an omniscient-controller reading without softening the actual information asymmetry.

E842 supplies a deliberately serious contrary comparison. Noa confiscates a recorder to protect privacy; later she proposes Truth or Dare, Yuuka reluctantly accepts, objects to answering about Sensei before others, chooses the unpleasant drink and ends up consuming almost all the mixture. Noa’s own unflustered underwear answer cannot become a universal openness standard. Yuuka’s enjoyment of games cannot become assent to every private subject or fair burden. Her later sleep utterance retains the cost without inventing poisoning, clinical injury or treatment.

The argument also keeps its recipients straight. Noa’s admission that she cannot know Sensei’s feelings and her apology for possible discomfort establish a limit on mind-reading, but are not reallocated as an apology to Yuuka. The apology for a one-sided game answers those local recipients, not every chased person or the later disclosure burden. Continued play, cleanup and wanted peaceful days therefore supply continuity without completing repair. This is a substantive strength of the draft, not a remote disclaimer added after an otherwise totalizing claim.

## 5. Public cooperation and independent peers

Pavane contributes real inquiry, Eridu location and continued intervention beyond a coordinates assignment. The draft lets that public usefulness count. It preserves Engineering, C&C, Eimi, Himari, Alice and other coalition actors as independently necessary rather than granting every rescue step to the pair. A successful interruption or rescue contribution is not an audited account of Rio’s spending, permanent safety or complete institutional legitimacy.

Final C003E006 is an actual disagreement in safety reasoning. Yuuka worries about Alice with Rio absent; Noa reports sending Alice and Game Development to the ship because Rio likely has more control inside Millennium. The complete accepted small episode argument supports the report and uncertainty, while u0037/u0045 self-address drift prevents clean quotation of every heading. The draft does not turn the report into inspected surveillance or guaranteed safety. This is enough to show different judgments within coordination.

Yuuka’s own pressuring acts remain consequential: the refused arithmetic drill, the profitable maid-work continuation proposal and next-afternoon compulsory filing involve different recipients. E842’s ending shows ongoing work and complaints, not completed filing, payment or universal assent. The draft consequently avoids giving privacy-holder status blanket innocence. Likewise, public competence does not excuse a private question, and a private objection does not erase crisis competence.

## 6. Ordering, written language and actor bounds

G31 has a local budget/design/build/output/conversation/coda sequence. Its separate Himari–Chihiro exchange gives reader-facing information and cannot be assigned as knowledge heard by Noa and Yuuka. The transferred book and recent award/fund crash do not produce an absolute calendar. E842’s appended E011–015 revisit party exchanges despite appearing after the next-afternoon scene. The draft correctly blocks an invented ordering in which the disclosure game follows the afternoon filing assignment.

Sports comparisons remain inherited complete character arguments with consequential actor seams; a borrowed-item prompt, denial and restricted memorandum do not securely disclose a confession or document contents. A wanted dance is not performed. Variants supply different contexts, not a compulsory maturity ladder. These limits are part of the actual argument rather than a justification for dropping ordinary scenes.

The use of `ユウカちゃん`, `大好き` and `聞かれてませんし？` is narrow and functional: familiar affection and a selective information explanation. GROUP3103u0021’s qualified Noa question is distinguished from clean Yuuka u0022–0023 and Noa’s u0024 interpretation. Sensei is absent in that group packet. Seven group seams and event-specific label, inward, alternative and narrator modes prevent universal actor normalization or performed-tone claims. The draft preserves this without abandoning clean gratitude, objections, build, gifts, refusal and narrated endpoints.

## 7. Rival readings and open responsibilities

Four rivals receive serious evidence before being constrained. Benevolent teasing has affection, enjoyment, help and apologies, yet cannot stand in for Yuuka’s objections and actual cost. Omniscient manipulation has observation and withholding, yet conflicts with express uncertainty, admitted limits and Yuuka’s own choices. Office roles organize work, yet cannot explain away poetry, rooms, company, gifts or games. Continued company is positive, yet cannot certify an apology, fair distribution, full consent or durable repair. The draft’s preferred reading explains these competing facts more completely than either an ideal partnership or an absolute controller/victim account.
